narration: 68% of American workers have zero long-term disability coverage. That's not a gap — it's a financial cliff, and here's why it's so dangerous.
visual: Dark background. Giant '68%' text in blue springs in. Person silhouette walks toward a cliff edge. 'NO COVERAGE' flashes red at the bottom. Subtitle: 'The financial cliff nobody warns you about.'

narration: Wild, right? You're 7 times more likely to become disabled than to die during your career. One in four workers lives this before retirement — so let's talk real money.
visual: Light background. Coffin icon on left labeled '1×'. Wheelchair icon on right labeled 'DISABILITY'. Large '7×' springs in between them. Bottom stat: '1 in 4 workers disabled before retirement.'

narration: The average disability lasts 34.6 months — nearly three years without your full paycheck. For a $55K salary, that's $165,000 in lost wages. And your workplace plan won't cover it.
visual: Dark background. Calendar grid fills in month by month (34.6 cells highlighted in blue). Red money bar drains to empty. '$165,000' springs in large at the bottom.

narration: Your short-term disability pays 60% of your salary — but only for six months. After that, you get zero. Your bills don't pause for your recovery. But here's what most workers don't know.
visual: Light background. Vertical income bar drops from 100% (blue) to 60% (blue) to empty (red). House icon on right labeled 'Bills don't pause.' Red text appears: 'Month 7 — you're completely exposed.'

narration: Here's the thing — real long-term disability coverage costs just 1 to 3% of your salary. That's $50 to $150 a month to protect your entire income. And you might already have access to it.
visual: Dark background. Blue shield with dollar sign springs in, green checkmark appears. Two comparison bars: small green 'COST' bar ($50-$150/mo) vs large blue 'INCOME PROTECTED' bar. '$50/MO' springs in large.

narration: Log into your HR portal and search for long-term disability today. Most employers already offer it — you just never checked the box. Don't find out you had nothing when it's too late.
visual: Light background. Laptop with benefits portal on screen showing LTD checkbox ticked. Three blue checklist steps appear one by one. CTA: 'Check your benefits today.'
